text: The UEBA system flagged CMP2946's activity for the week ending 2011-02-27 due to evidence from triggered rules. Specifically, it detected an unusual number of visits to job-search sites, with 7 instances this week compared to their typical range of 0 and a prior high of 21 in the past year. This is also significantly above the average for peers in the same role, with only 1 instance reported among 65 colleagues.
